title: 第10章 垂死病中惊坐起
content_zh:
第10章垂死病中惊坐起
张安世的话倒是让朱棣稍稍舒了口气，死不了就好。
朱棣陡然想起了学里的事，他故作风轻云淡地道：“我听闻张軏在学里成日胡作非为，对了，还有朱勇和……一个叫张安世的，你既是他们朋友，这些可有假吗？”
果然，好事不出门，坏事传千里！
张安世道：“这都是以讹传讹，我们同窗之间偶尔玩闹是有的，可要说胡作非为，这从何提起？他们都是忠勇之后，所谓老子英雄儿好汉，却不知外头哪里有这样的流言。”
朱棣骑在马上，不置可否，显然未必相信张安世的话：“你是谁的后人？”
“这……”张安世沉默了片刻：“我不敢说。”
“为何？”
“怕你告诉我爹。”
朱棣哈哈一笑：“我若要为难你，现在便抓你去应天府，让你爹来领人，看来你这浑人和那张軏、张安世几个都不是什么好鸟，都是一丘之貉。”
张安世：“……”
朱棣随即道：“似尔等这群目无王法的人，这天底下总有人能治一治你们。”
张安世则是满不在乎地道：“我还有事，不和你啰嗦。”
朱棣目视着张安世，脸上略有几分松动，他堂堂天子，似乎也不想和一个毛头小子计较。
张安世见朱棣稍稍迟疑的样子，却是急了，再这样僵持下去，让张辅察觉可就糟了，这位指挥同知，可不管张安世是什么太子小舅哥的，索性心一横，便从袖里掏啊掏，拿出了几两碎银来：“也罢，相遇也是有缘，难得相会，这点银子，请诸位壮士去吃杯茶水。”
谁料朱棣见那碎银，脸色骤然变了。
他突然厉声大喝道：“你如何来的碎银？”
张安世狐疑道：“我阿姐给的呀，说男人出门在外，不能无钱防身。”
朱棣的脸色却越来越冷厉：“我说的不是这个，你这娃娃难道不知，太祖高皇帝在的时候，就曾下旨，即所谓：‘由是物价踊贵，钞法益坏不行。乃谕户部令有司悉收民间钱归官，依数换钞，不论更用铜钱’。”
朱棣顿了一顿，又道：“当今皇帝遵太祖高皇帝祖训，这几日又发明诏，一切交割起讫，都需宝钞，不得更用铜钱、银两吗？”

他不说还好，这么一说，张安世倒是想起来了。
在明朝初期，确实有一段时间，官府强令用纸钞，也就是朝廷发行的‘大明宝钞’进行买卖。
只不过纸钞到了洪武二十年的时候，就因为滥发，而开始不断地贬值，洪武二十年之后，这种情况就更加恶化了，譬如在洪武二十年的时候，一石米只需要一张一贯的宝钞就可购买，而到了现在永乐二年，一石米却成了十贯宝钞，区区十几年，纸钞的价值贬值了十倍。
当今皇帝朱棣，是打着靖难的名义进南京城的，除了说他的侄子建文皇帝身边有坏人之外，还有一个大义名分，就是说当时的皇帝朱允文推翻了太祖高皇帝的祖训，可他朱棣不一样，朱棣最爱自己的爹了，是祖宗之法的维护者，所以这位新皇帝在坐稳了江山之后，一琢磨，我爹当初不是禁绝了银钱流通吗？
那么作为最爱太祖高皇帝的儿子，朱棣当然决心贯彻这条法令，于是短短一个月之内，连发三道旨意，禁绝银钱，强令天下士农工商必须用宝钞进行采买和交割商品。
张安世想到这个，就忍不住乐了。
而朱棣此时虎目猛地一张，老子是皇帝，口含天宪，言出法随，旨意都下达了，眼前这个少年居然还敢背旨行事，这岂不是对着姚广孝骂秃驴？
“你笑什么？”
张安世道：“这个……有这样的旨意吗？呃……糟了，那我得赶紧将家里的宝钞换成金银才好。不然要吃大亏了。”
朱棣眼珠子都要掉下来了，不禁道：“你说什么？”
张安世很认真地道：“你我相遇也算是缘分，我这人心善，见不得人傻吃闷亏，我看这旨意下达之后，宝钞的价格又要暴跌了，若说再不换成金银，不出三五日，家里有宝钞的，怕是要赔得裤裆都不剩下。”
朱棣怒道：“皇帝的旨意也不遵行吗？”
“皇帝的旨意自然无人敢违逆，可是皇帝的旨意，也无法左右市场，原本不强下旨倒也还好，现在一旦下旨，反而要坏事了，我看……宝钞的价值一定暴跌，这些事说来你也不懂，我有经验。”
张安世也不是吹牛，大明的百姓其实还算是淳朴的，没有见过世面，而他两世为人，什么大风大浪没见过？什么法币，什么津巴布韦，又或者是魏玛德国时期的马克，哪一个没见过？
朱棣听罢，忍不住大笑：“你一小儿，也敢信口雌黄，妄议国家大事。”
他面露不善，可随即却又笑了，如果说方才只是面露讥讽，可现在的笑，却更多了几分揶揄。
朱棣摇摇头，心里想，朕与这么一个毛头小子在此胡缠什么。
于是大手一挥：“走吧。”
张安世顿时健步如飞，一下子消失得无影无踪。
只是他心里不由得嘀咕，这人是谁，脾气不小。

好在张安世也没有放在心上，他心里惦记着是不是该赶紧将张家的一些宝钞兑换成银子，不过很快却又释然了。
一方面其实他并不富裕，东宫虽然隔三差五都有赏赐，可毕竟现在自己的姐夫还没有当家作主，赏赐有限的很。
另一方面，他是太子的小舅子，皇帝这时下诏严禁银钱交易，他却率先兑换大量的银钱，这不是坑自己的姐夫吗？
要把持住自己啊。
千万别将姐夫坑了。
…………
此时，朱棣跨步进了张軏的卧房。
张軏正发出杀猪一般的嚎叫声：“疼啊，疼啊，腰都断了。”
朱棣皱眉，箭步上前，一掀被子：“打的不是屁股上吗？何况用鞭子抽打，怎么会断了腰？”
只见张軏脑袋一歪，好像昏厥过去了。
站在一旁的张辅，本是冷着的脸，此时多了几分怒容，道：“陛下在此，你还要胡闹吗？”
张軏没反应。
朱棣压压手，示意张辅道：“别吓着他。”
这个时候的张辅，也正还年轻，脸上却总显得严肃，比同龄人更令人感到沉稳。
他本在五军都督府当值，听说自己的兄弟又惹了祸，连忙赶了回来，此时陛下又摆驾来此，行礼道：“陛下，愚弟无状，恳请陛下……”
朱棣吁了口气道：“他不听管教，朕已惩罚了他，好啦，你也别吓着他了。”
张辅冷肃的脸上难得的多了一点平日难见的沮丧，道：“是，不过……臣这兄弟，从前倒也还好，可自从和张安世、朱能他们厮混一起之后……”
朱棣嗯了一声，不置可否地道：“先让御医看看伤势。”
此时，几个随来的御医便开始忙碌起来。
朱棣背着手，在这卧房里闲走几步，目光落在了床塌边几子上的一个瓷瓶上：“此乃何物？”

张家的仆人其实早已吓得一个个魂不附体了，都不敢抬头，只有张軏的长随期期艾艾地道：“这……这是少爷的朋友送来的药。”
朱棣颔首，突而道：“他那朋友，可叫郭得甘？朕方才见他爬墙出去。”
仆从惊得下巴都要掉下来。
这时医学奇迹发生了，本是躺在床上纹丝不动的张軏猝然惊起，立即抢答道：“对，叫郭得甘。”
张軏是讲义气的，他不能出卖大哥，傻子都看得出来，能翻墙，还不肯自报家门的家伙，非大哥莫属了，大哥就是这样，做事从来不肯留名。

Chapter 10: Sitting up in shock while dying of illness
Zhang Anshi's words actually made Zhu Di breathe a sigh of relief. It would be fine if he could not die.
Zhu Di suddenly remembered what happened in the school. He pretended to be calm and calm: "I heard that Zhang Fu has been doing mischief in the school all day long. By the way, there are also Zhu Yong and... a man named Zhang Anshi. Since you are their friend, is this true?"
Sure enough, good things don’t go out, but bad things spread thousands of miles!
Zhang Anshi said: "This is all rumors. There are occasional jokes among our classmates, but when it comes to misbehavior, where does it come from? They are all loyal and brave, so-called heroes, but I don't know where such rumors exist outside."
Zhu Di was riding on the horse, noncommittal, obviously not necessarily believing Zhang Anshi's words: "Whose descendant are you?"
"This..." Zhang Anshi was silent for a moment: "I dare not say it."
"Why?"
"I'm afraid you'll tell my dad."
Zhu Di laughed and said, "If I want to embarrass you, I will take you to Yingtian Mansion now and let your father come and pick you up. It seems that you and Zhang Fu and Zhang Anshi are not good birds. They are all the same."
Zhang Anshi: "..."
Zhu Di immediately said: "It seems like you and other people who have no law, there will always be someone in this world who can cure you."
Zhang Anshi said nonchalantly: "I still have something to do, so I won't bother you."
Zhu Di looked at Zhang Anshi, his face slightly relaxed. He was a majestic emperor and didn't seem to want to argue with a young boy.
Seeing Zhu Di's slight hesitation, Zhang Anshi became anxious. If the stalemate continued like this, it would be bad for Zhang Fu to notice. The commander knew that no matter who Zhang Anshi was, he was the brother-in-law of the prince. He simply took out a few taels of silver from his sleeves and said, "Well, we are destined to meet each other. It is rare to meet each other. With this little silver, I invite all you heroes to have a cup of tea."
Unexpectedly, when Zhu Di saw the broken silver, his expression suddenly changed.
He suddenly shouted loudly: "How did you get the broken silver?"
Zhang Anshi said suspiciously: "My sister gave it to me. She said that a man should not have money to defend himself when he goes out."
Zhu Di's face became increasingly cold and stern: "That's not what I'm talking about. Don't you know, little kid, that when Taizu Emperor Gao was still here, he issued an edict: 'Because the price of goods is so high, the currency law is getting worse. He ordered the Ministry of Household Affairs to collect private money and return it to the official, and exchange it for banknotes according to the number, no matter how much copper coins are used."
Zhu Di paused for a moment and then said: "The current emperor follows the ancestral precepts of Emperor Taizu Gao. In the past few days, he has issued an edict that all delivery starts and ends with treasure banknotes. Isn't it allowed to use copper coins and silver taels?"
It's okay if he didn't say it, but when he said that, Zhang Anshi remembered it.
In the early Ming Dynasty, there was indeed a period when the government forced the use of banknotes, the "Ming Dynasty Treasure Notes" issued by the court, for transactions.
It's just that in the 20th year of Hongwu, banknotes began to depreciate due to excessive issuance. After 20 years of Hongwu, the situation worsened. For example, in the 20th year of Hongwu, one stone of rice could be purchased with just one banknote. But now in the second year of Yongle, one stone of rice has become ten banknotes. In just ten years, the value of banknotes has depreciated tenfold.
The current emperor Zhu Di entered Nanjing in the name of Jingnan. In addition to saying that his nephew Emperor Jianwen had bad people around him, he also had a righteous claim, that is, he said that the then emperor Zhu Yunwen overthrew Emperor Taizu Gao. The emperor's ancestral precepts were different, but Zhu Di was different. Zhu Di loved his father the most and was the defender of the ancestral laws. So after the new emperor established his position in the country, he thought about it, didn't my father ban the circulation of money in the first place?
As the son of Emperor Gao who loved Taizu the most, Zhu Di was of course determined to implement this decree. So in just one month, he issued three edicts in a row, prohibiting money, and forcing farmers, industry and merchants all over the world to use treasure money to purchase and deliver goods.
Zhang Anshi couldn't help but feel happy when he thought of this.
At this time, Zhu DiThe tiger's eyes suddenly opened. I am the emperor. He speaks the constitution of heaven and obeys the law. His will is issued. The young man in front of me actually dares to act contrary to the order. Isn't this like scolding Yao Guangxiao?
"What are you laughing at?"
Zhang Anshi said: "Does this... have such a purpose? Uh... Oh no, I have to quickly exchange the treasures at home into gold and silver. Otherwise, I will suffer a big loss."
Zhu Di's eyes almost fell down and he couldn't help but said: "What did you say?"
Zhang Anshi said seriously: "It's fate that you and I met. I'm a kind-hearted person, and I don't want others to suffer stupid losses. I think after this decree is issued, the price of treasure banknotes will plummet again. If we don't exchange it for gold and silver, within three to five days, those who have treasure banknotes at home will lose their pants."
Zhu Di said angrily: "Don't you also obey the emperor's will?"
"Naturally, no one dares to disobey the emperor's will, but the emperor's will cannot influence the market. It was okay if he didn't force the decree. Now, once the decree is issued, it will be bad. I think... the value of the treasure banknotes will definitely plummet. You don't understand these things. I have experience."
Zhang Anshi is not bragging. The people of the Ming Dynasty are actually quite simple and have never seen the world. But in his two lifetimes, what kind of storms and waves has he not seen? What kind of legal currency, what kind of Zimbabwe, or the mark from the Weimar Germany period, which one have you never seen?
After Zhu Di heard this, he couldn't help but laugh: "You, a little kid, dare to talk nonsense and talk about national affairs."
He looked unkind, but then he smiled again. If it was just a sarcastic expression just now, his smile now was a bit more teasing.
Zhu Di shook his head and thought to himself, what am I doing with such a young boy?
So he waved his hand: "Let's go."
Zhang Anshi suddenly walked quickly and disappeared without a trace.
But he couldn't help but murmur in his heart, who is this person? He has a bad temper.
Fortunately, Zhang Anshi didn't take it to heart. He was thinking about whether he should quickly exchange some of the Zhang family's treasure notes into silver, but he soon felt relieved.
On the one hand, he is actually not rich. Although the East Palace receives rewards every now and then, after all, his brother-in-law is not the master of the family yet, so the rewards are very limited.
On the other hand, he is the prince's brother-in-law. At this time, the emperor issued an edict to strictly prohibit money transactions, but he took the lead in exchanging a large amount of money. Isn't this cheating his brother-in-law?
Have to hold on to yourself.
Don't trick your brother-in-law.
…………
At this time, Zhu Di stepped into Zhang Fu's bedroom.
Zhang Fu was howling like a slaughtering pig: "It hurts, it hurts, my waist is broken."
Zhu Di frowned, stepped forward, and lifted the quilt: "Didn't you hit me on the butt? What's more, if you hit him with a whip, how could you break your waist?"
Zhang Fu tilted his head and seemed to have fainted.
Zhang Fu, who was standing aside, had a cold face at first, but now he looked more angry and said: "Your Majesty is here, do you still want to fool around?"
Zhang Fu didn't respond.
Zhu Di pressed his hand and signaled to Zhang Fu: "Don't scare him."
At this time, Zhang Fu was still young, but his face always looked serious, making him feel calmer than his peers.
He was on duty at the Governor's Mansion of the Fifth Army. Hearing that his brother had caused trouble again, he hurried back. At this time, His Majesty came here again and saluted: "Your Majesty, I am a foolish brother. I beg your Majesty..."
Zhu Di breathed a sigh of relief and said, "He disobeyed discipline and I have punished him. Okay, don't scare him anymore."
Zhang Fu's cold and solemn face had a rare expression of frustration, and he said: "Yes, but... this brother Chen was fine in the past, but since he hung out with Zhang Anshi, Zhu Neng and the others..."
Zhu Di hummed and said noncommittally: "Let the doctor check the injury first."
At this time, several imperial doctors who came with him began to get busy.
Zhu Di took a few steps in the bedroom with his hands behind his back, and his eyes fell on a figure sitting on the edge of the bed.On the porcelain bottle: "What is this?"
In fact, all the servants of the Zhang family were so frightened that they didn't dare to raise their heads. Only Zhang Fu's chief servant Qi Ai Ai said: "This... this is the medicine sent by the young master's friend."
Zhu Di nodded and suddenly said: "His friend's name is Guo Degan? I just saw him climb out of the wall."
The servant's jaw dropped.
At this time, a medical miracle happened. Zhang Fu, who was lying motionless on the bed, suddenly woke up and immediately answered: "Yes, my name is Guo Degan."
Zhang Fu is loyal. He cannot betray his eldest brother. Even a fool can see that the guy who can climb over the wall and refuses to declare his family name must be the eldest brother. The eldest brother is like this, never willing to leave his name when doing things.
